title: The box that made everything cheap
hook_variants: The most important invention in your house is a metal box.
This boring box is why everything you own is cheap.
Before 1956, shipping was a nightmare. Then came the box.

scenes.say: The reason everything you own is cheap? A metal box.
Yes. Me. Let me tell you my origin story.
Before containers, workers loaded sacks and crates by hand. Ships sat in port for days.
In 1956 Malcom McLean shipped the first containers. Loading cost fell more than ninety percent.
scenes.label: LOADING COST

scenes.say: One standard box fits ships, trains and trucks. No unpacking. No theft. No waiting.
Globalisation wasn't only politics. It was a box.
Follow Landed Costs. I'm literally the main character.

caption: In 1956 Malcom McLean shipped the first containers. Loading costs dropped by over 90% and global trade exploded. The box changed everything. 📦🌍
